notes.bbb_note: The label does not state whether simvastatin crosses the blood-brain barrier or acts on the central nervous system.
notes.safety_note: The main warning is 'Myopathy and Rhabdomyolysis' (Section 5.1), which states that simvastatin may cause myopathy and rhabdomyolysis, with acute kidney injury secondary to myoglobinuria and rare fatalities having occurred as a result.
